name: Shotalashu
question: Should one-time acquisition / downtime prerequisite checks (here: +4 circumstance to the DC 21 Occultism check to bond with a shotalashu, for characters with telepathy) ever surface as situational bonuses, or are only in-play bonuses in scope?
evidence: "Any creature with telepathic capabilities, such as telepathy, touch telepathy, empathic sense, or the ability to cast spells such as telepathy, gains a +4 circumstance bonus to this check." — 'this check' being the "DC 21 Occultism check to establish a telepathic link" needed to acquire the companion.

name: Eldritch Archer Dedication
question: Should the granted cantrip be delivered through the innate lane (like Minor Magic's grantAs:'innate' at-will) or as a real one-cantrip SPONTANEOUS repertoire with a Charisma-keyed spell attack/DC? The text says repertoire, and later Eldritch Archer feats add to it — but the innate lane is the one that exists today.
evidence: "You gain a spell repertoire with one cantrip of your choice, from a tradition of your choice. ... This cantrip must require a spell attack roll and come from your chosen tradition."

name: Marshall Fiendish Forces
question: There is no bestiary in core.json, so this pick has nothing to pick from. Free-text field (player types the fiend's name), or leave the feat prose-only until creature data ships?
evidence: "This fiend is a common fiend of level 11 or lower, which you select when you take this feat. ... At 20th level, you can choose a common fiend of level 15 or lower to appear instead"

name: Sanctified Relic
question: Same call as Patron Reborn, and it also decides the shape here: prompt for build-time picks that only benefit an NPC hierophant? If yes, do you want this as ONE choice with 2 picks plus a separate holy/unholy choice, or a single flattened option list? FeatChoiceDef has no `picks` count today — every existing use is pick-one.
evidence: "When you take this feat, choose two attributes (one of which must be your key attribute) as your divine attributes and either holy or unholy sanctification; if you have the holy or unholy trait through a class feature or other ability, you must choose that same trait."

name: Assume Godhood
question: This feat has THREE separate build-time picks and none of them touch your own sheet — the three follower spells, "one skill you are legendary in to act as your divine skill", and "one other attribute of your choosing" for your divine attributes. Prompt for all of them as record-only, prompt for none, or something in between?
evidence: "When you Assume Godhood, choose three spells from any list other than the divine list; one must be 1st rank, one must be 2nd or 3rd rank, and one can be of any rank. These spells become additional cleric spells you can grant to your followers."

name: Breakthrough Innovation
question: Should the picker offer breakthrough modifications only, or breakthrough + initial as the text allows? And which innovation type does light-mortar-innovation count as for this filter — weapon?
evidence: "Choose a breakthrough modification of your innovation's type to apply to your innovation. You can choose an initial modification of your innovation's type instead if you prefer."

name: Endless Memories
question: Do you want daily-preparation temporary proficiencies (Ancient Memories / Endless Memories) modelled as a play-state daily-prep control, given the rules explicitly bar using them as prerequisites — or is a sheet reminder enough?
evidence: "When you choose a skill in which to become trained with Ancient Memories, you can also choose a skill in which you're already trained and become an expert in that skill. This lasts until your Ancient Memories expires."

name: Kinetic Gate
question: Single vs Dual Gate is currently implicit (pick 1 vs 2 elements in the same picker) and Single Gate's automatic impulse junction is not granted. Do you want (a) an explicit Single/Dual Gate toggle in Setup, (b) auto-granting the chosen element's impulse junction when only one element is picked, and (c) two extra level-1 'impulse' feat slots for the gate's free impulse feats?
evidence: "You can choose either a single gate (one element) or dual gate (two elements) at 1st level." … "you can pick from six elements - air, earth, fire metal, water, and wood"

name: Weapon Legend
question: Weapon Legend RAW lets you pick a DIFFERENT weapon group than the one Fighter Weapon Mastery raised at level 5, but the app stores only one group (build.fighterWeaponGroup) and just promotes it to legendary at 13. Do you want a second, independent group pick at level 13, or is the simplification intentional?
evidence: "You can select one weapon group and increase your proficiency ranks to legendary for all simple weapons, martial weapons, and unarmed attacks in that weapon group, and to master for all advanced weapons in that weapon group."

name: Blessing of the Devoted
question: Blessed Armament / Blessed Shield need item-targeted grants (pick a weapon or handwraps, then pick one of five property runes; or auto-apply a level-scaled Reinforcing rune to your shield) which the engine cannot express today. Ship all three options with only Blessed Swiftness mechanised and the other two as recorded-but-prose picks, or hold the whole feature until an item-targeting lane exists?
evidence: "Your deity blesses your service with a boon. … Choose one of the following blessings, or any other to which you have access."

name: Divine Spark and Ikons
question: Should each weapon/worn ikon get a bound inventory item (the free level-0 item it grants, which is also where its runes are etched)? Without it, an exemplar's ikon runes and the 'body ikon acts as handwraps' rule cannot be represented.
evidence: "As an exemplar, you select three ikons at first level."

name: Thaumaturge's Demesne
question: Do you want an optional free-text 'demesne' note captured on this feat for flavour, or should it stay prose-only with no prompt?
evidence: "When you select this feat, choose a demesne, an area of no more than 2,000 square feet. You must legitimately own the area or, if its a public area, you must lay claim to the area without anyone contesting it."

name: Split Slot
question: Should Split Slot add a real extra prepared-spell slot at the chosen rank (which overstates power, since only one of the two paired spells can be cast), or should it only record the rank + show a note on the Spells page?
evidence: "you can choose one spell slot at least 1 rank lower than the highest-rank spell you can cast and prepare two spells in that slot. When you Cast a Spell from that slot, choose which spell to cast."

name: Unlimited Pluripotency
question: Do you want a play-time (daily-preparation) heritage swap for Unlimited Pluripotency, or is leaving it as descriptive text acceptable given heritage is a fixed build field?
evidence: "When you sleep, you can choose to enter a pupa state. … you lose the benefits of one of your surki heritages overnight. When you emerge and make your daily preparations, you can select a different surki heritage to replace it."

name: Peerless Mascot Companion
question: Peerless Mascot Companion makes two picks - the specialization (usual list OR the new 'peerless mascot') and one language the companion learns. Do you want 'peerless-mascot' added as a real companionSpecializations record and a companion-language field added, or is the prose note currently in companionGrants.ts good enough?
evidence: "You can select one of the usual specializations or the peerless mascot specialization." ... "It can speak one language that you also speak (chosen at the time you gain this feat)."

name: Built-In Tools
question: Do you want a display-only picker for feats like this (a genuine build-time selection with no number attached in HH), or should such feats stay prose-only until the underlying rule — the worn-tools limit — is modeled?
evidence: "When you take this feat, choose up to two sets of tools you own, such as thieves' tools or healer's tools, that weigh a total of 2 Bulk or less… The innovation's Bulk doesn't increase from this addition."

name: Apotropaic Fulu
question: Should consumables whose variant is fixed at creation but that affect nobody on the sheet (Apotropaic Fulu's warded alignment) get a per-instance flavour label, or is the pick left to the table? Note this is legacy-era content — alignment traits no longer exist post-Remaster, so the four options themselves are dead vocabulary.
evidence: "Pick an alignment trait: chaotic, good, lawful, or evil."

name: Captivating Score
question: Captivating Score's Positive/Negative (and its subject and instrument) are baked into each written copy but change nothing the engine calculates. Do consumables whose choice is pure flavour/record-keeping deserve a stored per-copy note field, or should the app stay silent on them? Answering this once covers a whole family of 'compose/inscribe it this way' consumables.
evidence: "You choose one of the emotions described below and write a musical composition to convey that emotion about a subject of your choice, typically a person or group."

name: Faith Tattoo
question: The tattoo carries a SECOND build-time choice: "When you get the tattoo and aren't sanctified, you can choose to sanctify yourself to your deity." Does the app model sanctification as a character-level field an item can set (normally it arrives via cleric/champion class features), and if so should this item be allowed to grant it? The `choice` shape holds only one choice per record, so if sanctification is in scope it needs either a second slot or its own field. Same question applies to all four Faith Tattoo grades.
evidence: "You can choose harm or heal only in accord with the deity's divine font. If the deity allows either spell, choose one the tattoo can cast when you receive the tattoo."

name: Faith Tattoo (Greater)
question: Same as base Faith Tattoo: is the optional self-sanctification ("When you get the tattoo and aren't sanctified, you can choose to sanctify yourself to your deity") something an item may set, and where would that live?
evidence: "The tattoo casts a 3rd-rank Harm, Heal, or the 3rd-rank spell from your deity's cleric spells ... If the deity allows either spell, choose one the tattoo can cast when you receive the tattoo."

name: Faith Tattoo (Major)
question: Same as base Faith Tattoo: is the optional self-sanctification something an item may set, and where would that live?
evidence: "The tattoo casts a 5th-rank Harm, Heal, or the 5th-rank spell from your deity's cleric spells ... If the deity allows either spell, choose one the tattoo can cast when you receive the tattoo."

name: Faith Tattoo (True)
question: Same as base Faith Tattoo: is the optional self-sanctification something an item may set, and where would that live?
evidence: "The tattoo casts a 7th-rank Harm, Heal, or the 7th-rank spell from your deity's cleric spells ... If the deity allows either spell, choose one the tattoo can cast when you receive the tattoo."

name: Taper of Sanctification
question: Should this ship as two variant item records — Taper of Sanctification (Holy) / (Unholy), the way item grades are already split — rather than as a choice? EffectChoice picks are keyed `<recordId>:<choiceId>`, i.e. per item DEFINITION, so a character holding one holy and one unholy taper could not be represented. Related: the candle is also "dedicated to a deity who can be sanctified to holy or unholy" — do you want the deity recorded on the item at all, or is it pure flavour?
evidence: "If the deity's sanctification lists both options, the crafter must choose one when the candle is made."

name: Essence Forge
question: The four forge types (life / matter / mind / spirit) are real, distinct items — should they become four variant records (or a display-only label on the owned item) so the sheet can show which one the party has? They confer no character-sheet effect, so I did not spec a mechanical choice. Also: this base record is an umbrella AoN dump duplicating the three graded records below — should it be hidden from item pickers?
evidence: "Choose an item whose formula you have and whose level is equal to or less than the essence forge's level, or choose an essence charm" — inside **Activate—Craft an Item** (2 hours).

name: Awakened Metal Shot
question: core.json ALREADY has the split variant `awakened-cold-iron-shot` (a proper standalone item with price, activationCost and descRefs). Should `aon-awakened-metal-shot` be retired as a duplicate umbrella, split into three items (adamantine/cold iron/silver), or kept and given a purchase-time variant selector? This is a content-curation call, not a rules reading.
evidence: Three consecutive unlabelled paragraphs: "The shot is a high-grade adamantine bullet." / "The shot is a high-grade cold iron bullet." / "The shot is a high-grade silver bullet." — with no "choose" verb anywhere.

name: Dragon Deviant Classification
question: There is no deviant subsystem in the app at all — a full-text scan of src/ for /deviant/ returns ZERO matches, this record is in no class's feature list and no subclass/extraChoice option list, and only one deviant feat ('ghostly-grasp-deviant') exists in core.json out of the whole Dark Archive set. Before this choice can be surfaced anywhere, do you want deviant abilities modelled at all, and if so where does the classification get picked — a Setup card like the GMG variant rules, or attached to the Deviant Ability archetype's feats?
evidence: "When you gain a dragon-type deviation, choose a type of damage, from cold, electricity, fire, or sonic. All abilities you gain from this deviation deal this type of damage and add the corresponding trait to the ability."

name: Elemental Magic
question: Is the Elementalist class archetype in scope at all? It restructures the SPELL LIST itself ('Replace your spell list with the elemental spell list'), a lane the app has never needed. If yes, it also needs a `classArchetype` field — today only 4 records in all of core.json have one (vindicator-dedication, warrior-of-legend-dedication, palatine-detective-dedication, war-mage-dedication), all on FEATS, and this record carries only the bare `otherTags: ['class-archetype']`.
evidence: "You must choose an elemental philosophy (detailed below), which determines which spells and other elemental magic you can use."

name: Elemental School
question: This record is an ORPHAN — it is not one of the wizard's 14 arcane-school subclass options, and nothing in src/ reads its `otherTags: ['wizard-elemental-school']`. It only exists to serve the Elementalist class archetype (`elemental-magic`). Should it be wired at all, and if so does it become a 15th wizard arcane-school option that is hidden unless the Elementalist archetype is taken?
evidence: "your curriculum spells can be any spells that you have access to and that have your chosen element's trait. Your school spells are the elemental focus spells of your chosen element"

name: Perpetual Infusions (Bomber)
question: This record is an ORPHAN and looks superseded. The shipped alchemist is the REMASTER (Player Core 2) one — its features are versatile vials / advanced-vials / abundant-vials / alchemical-mastery, and `perpetual-infusions-bomber` (source: Pathfinder Core Rulebook, OGL) appears in NO class feature list, no subclass option list and no extraChoices group. Should legacy alchemist features be wired up at all, or hidden by the legacy/superseded edition rule?
evidence: "Choose two 1st-level bombs." / "You gain the ability to create two 1st-level alchemical items using Quick Alchemy without spending a batch of infused reagents."

name: Perpetual Perfection (Bomber)
question: Same legacy question as the Perpetual Infusions set: this is a 17th-level Core Rulebook (OGL) alchemist feature that the Player Core 2 remaster replaced, and it is in no class feature list, subclass option list or extraChoices group. Wire up legacy alchemist, or leave hidden as superseded?
evidence: "Choose two 11th-level or lower bombs."

name: Perpetual Perfection (Chirurgeon)
question: Same legacy question as the Perpetual Infusions set: 17th-level Core Rulebook (OGL) feature superseded by the Player Core 2 alchemist, present in no class feature list, subclass option list or extraChoices group. Wire up legacy alchemist, or leave hidden as superseded?
evidence: "Choose two 11th-level or lower elixirs with the healing trait."

name: Perpetual Perfection (Mutagenist)
question: Same legacy question as the Perpetual Infusions set: 17th-level Core Rulebook (OGL) feature superseded by the Player Core 2 alchemist, present in no class feature list, subclass option list or extraChoices group. Wire up legacy alchemist, or leave hidden as superseded? (Note: only three Perpetual Perfection records were in this chunk — check whether a toxicologist variant exists and got the same treatment.)
evidence: "Choose two 11th-level or lower mutagens."

name: Perpetual Potency (Toxicologist)
question: When a toxicologist reaches 17th level and gains Perpetual Perfection, do the two 5th-level picks from Perpetual Potency remain (4 free items total), or are they replaced by the two new 11th-level picks? RAW reads as replacement/upgrade of the same slot but the app owner should confirm how many perpetual slots to show.
evidence: "Choose two common 5th-level or lower alchemical poisons."

name: Sign Bound
question: The text says a player might be born under a non-Cosmic-Caravan constellation and 'gain different benefits as determined by the GM'. Should the picker include a 14th 'Other (GM-determined)' option that grants nothing mechanically, or list only the 13 printed signs?
evidence: "When you gain this background, choose a specific constellation, such as the Thrush or the Wagon. Your associated constellation determines one of the ability boosts you gain and an innate spell."

name: Lurlup
question: Is sanctification (holy/unholy) in scope as a mechanical build choice, or does Heroes Heaven deliberately leave it narrative? It requires a new Deity field backfilled across all 485 deities plus a choice on the cleric `sanctification` class feature — a collection-wide project, not a per-record fix. If it stays narrative, Lurlup needs NO choice and this result should be treated as needsBuildChoice=false.
evidence: "**Sanctification** Can be Unholy" (and, for contrast, the non-choices: "**Divine Font** Harm", "**Divine Skill** Intimidation", "**Favored Weapon** Dagger", "**Domains** Destruction, Indulgence, Void, Plague")
